"""Account the ten original V167 owners and actual support-bound records."""
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))
training=read(root/'status-v1.json');post=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert training['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review'
assert post['status']=='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
assert set(training['completed'])=={'parity','smoke','train'}
assert set(post['completed'])=={'checkpoint-validation','review','scores','metric-audit','render'}
assert all(v['returncode']==0 for v in post['completed'].values())
owners=[('training-controller',training['owner'])]+[(n,read(root/f'{n}-result-v1.json')['owner']) for n in ['parity','smoke','train']]
owners += [('postprocess-controller',post['owner'])]+[(n,v['owner']) for n,v in post['completed'].items()]
assert len(owners)==len({(o['pid'],o['created']) for _,o in owners})==10
records=[]
for stage,owner in owners:
 assert not live(owner),(stage,owner)
 try:
  p=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);terminal='PID-reused-original-terminal' if abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])>=.01 else p.status()
 except psutil.NoSuchProcess:terminal='absent'
 records.append({'stage':stage,'owner':owner,'terminal_state':terminal})
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');assert review['component_forwards']==3288 and review['new_prediction_arrays']==review['control_replayed_exact']==1644
paths=set();newpaths=set();controls=review_images=bound_rows=0
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
 c=read(binding['path']);assert c['component_forwards']==822
 forward=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['forward_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
 observations=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['observation_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
 assert [r['returned_forwards'] for r in forward]==list(range(1,823)) and observations==c['observations']
 control=c['arm']=='routed-control';assert c['adopted_array_storage_after_actual_replay']==control
 for row in observations:
  p=Path(row['prediction']['path']);assert p.is_relative_to('/mnt/external') and str(p) not in paths
  paths.add(str(p));assert row['archive_replayed_bit_exact']==control
  floor=0. if control else .25
  assert row['declared_support_floor']==floor and floor<=row['support_minimum']<=row['support_maximum']<=1
  bound_rows+=1;review_images+=row['inputs']['packed']['shape'][0]
  if control:controls+=1
  else:newpaths.add(str(p))
assert len(paths)==3288 and len(newpaths)==controls==1644 and bound_rows==3288
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json');assert parity['component_forward_evaluations']==56 and len(parity['rows'])==28
assert len(parity['CUDA_support_floor_checks'])==4 and len(parity['CUDA_anchor_loss_checks'])==10 and len(parity['CUDA_pair_unit_loss_checks'])==6 and len(parity['CUDA_pair_common_loss_checks'])==4
calls=parity['component_forward_evaluations']+sum(read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json')['counts'].values())+sum(read(root/'train-result-v1.json')['counts'].values())+review['component_forwards']
assert calls==5364
baseline={r['id']:r for r in read(plan['baseline_collection']['path'])['observations']}
parity_images=2*sum(baseline[r['id']]['inputs']['packed']['shape'][0] for r in parity['rows'])
cache=read(plan['cache']['path'])['batches'];training_images=2*sum(v['inputs']['packed']['shape'][0] for v in cache)
smoke_images=2*sum(v['inputs']['packed']['shape'][0] for v in cache[:10]);images=parity_images+training_images+smoke_images+review_images
assert images==11424
excluded={os.getpid()}|{p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()};matching=[]
for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline','status']):
 if p.pid in excluded or p.info['status'] in ['zombie','dead']:continue
 if any(t==str(root) or t.startswith(str(root)+'/') for t in p.info['cmdline'] or []):matching.append(p.info)
assert not matching,matching
output=root/'execution-completion-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'all10-original-scientific-owners-terminal','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'recorded_owner_count':10,'owners':records,
 'live_matching_root_argv':matching,'head_calls':calls,'main_head_calls':calls,'head_image_evaluations':images,'main_head_images':images,
 'parity_head_images':parity_images,'training_head_images':training_images,'smoke_head_images':smoke_images,'review_head_images':review_images,
 'parity_leaf_backwards':24,'additional_leaf_output_CUDA_backwards':24,'motivation_root_calls':0,
 'actual_parent_root_calls':0,'actual_DINO_backbone_calls':0,'new_source_constructions':0,'new_sensor_sampler_calls':0,
 'cache_batches_reused':1000,'unique_training_observations_reused':4000,'scientific_stage_failures':0,'full_training_restarts':0,
 'review_root_calls':3288,'control_prediction_replays_exact':1644,'new_prediction_arrays':1644,'review_support_bound_records':3288,
 'new_array_bytes':sum(Path(p).stat().st_size for p in newpaths),'training_completion':ref(root/'status-v1.json'),
 'postprocess_completion':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json'),'unit_and_inherited_mask_audit':ref(root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json'),
 'actual_training_objective_and_bounds':ref(root/'training-objective-audit-v1.json'),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
 'scope':'Ten original owners terminal.5364 root calls/11424 actual head images;24 CUDA leaf checks separate,no motivation inference. Exact V166 control trace/raw/EMA/Adam and1644 actual outputs. Configured support extrema verified on all3288 original review rows. Quarter-floor architecture is only intervention;all89 prior neural sources and old evidence unchanged plus1new module. No quality or flat-safety guarantee.'})
print('PASS10 original owners terminal;5364 roots/11424 images;3288 support-bound rows')
